title: Python short_addr.py: switch DAD from CRC32 to FNV-1a32
description: python/src/lichen/link/short_addr.py uses CRC32 for derive_short_addr(). Update to FNV-1a32 (basis 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193) per spec/02-physical-link.md 4.5. Test against test/vectors/short_addr_dad.json 'derived' field.
close_reason: Obsolete: CRC32 is intentional for short-addr DAD per project-LICHEN-bo37; short_addr.py uses crc32_ieee. FNV-1a is for TDMA/channel only.
